title: GOTCHA: overlay save() writes LOCAL fields only — new fields default to graph-store
summary: overlay.js save() does NOT serialize all fields to the overlay JSON file. Only LOCAL_FIELDS are written to disk: git, cancel_requested, stop_requested, config, judgedAtEpoch, judgeCursor, judgedClusters, distinctClusters. All other fields (assignee, timestamps, metrics, measurements, benchmarks, repos, edges, status, summaries, knowledge, note_nodes, snapshots) are SHARED fields that go to the graph-store via emitDiff() as append-only JSONL events. Adding a new field: if it is workspace-runtime state (ephemeral, safe to lose on crash) add it to LOCAL_FIELDS in the save() function. If it is durable knowledge that should survive across sessions and be queryable, do NOT put it in LOCAL_FIELDS — instead add an event type to emitDiff() and a case in graph-store.js loadGraph(). Putting a shared field in LOCAL_FIELDS causes it to disappear from the graph on daemon restart and breaks cross-session memory.
